```{r results='asis'}
source("carousel/carousel.R")
include_images <- function(module_name) {
  folder <- file.path("images/modules", module_name)
  paths <- sort(Sys.glob(paste0(folder, "/*.png")))

  gallery_id <- paste0(module_name, "-gallery")

  
  if(length(paths) == 1){
    cat(paste0("![](", paths, "){.card-single-img .lightbox group='", gallery_id, "'}"))
  } else {
    desc <- list()
    for (path in paths) desc[[length(desc)+1]] <- list(image = path, link = path)
   carousel(gallery_id, 5000, desc)
  }
}
```

```{r results='asis'}

textmodule_template <- r"----(
<div class="textmodule">
<div class="header">
<div class="heading">
<strong>%s</strong>
</div>
<div class="subheading">
by [{%s}](%s){target='_blank'}
</div>
</div>
<div class="textcard">
%s
</div>
</div>
)----"

build_textmodule <- function(name, package_name, url, description) {
  cat(sprintf(textmodule_template, name, package_name, url, description))
}

```

```{r results='asis'}

module_template_pre <- r"----(
<div class="module" data-usecase="%s">
<div class="header">
<div class="heading">
<strong>%s</strong>
</div>
<div class="subheading">
by [{%s}](%s){target='_blank'}
</div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-inner">
<div class="card-front">
)----"

module_template_post <- r"----(
<div class="usecase">
<strong>Use case</strong>: %s
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-back">
%s
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
)----"

build_module <- function(usecase, name, package_name, url, image_folder, description) {
  cat(sprintf(module_template_pre, usecase, name, package_name, url))
  cat(knitr::raw_html(toString((include_images(image_folder)))))
  cat(sprintf(module_template_post, usecase, description))
}


```

```{=html}
<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  // gets reference of filter (line 122) and saves it in new var
  // parent element for buttons, buttons are added to this parent element in function "createButton"
  var filterContainer = document.querySelector(".filter");


  // returns array with references of all elements of type module
  var modules = document.querySelectorAll(".module");
  
  // collect use cases without duplicates
  var usecases = []; // empty array

  for (var i = 0; i < modules.length; i++) {
    // accessing attribute "data-usecase" with dataset.usecase
    var text = modules[i].dataset.usecase;
    var values = text.split(","); // creates array with seperated use cases

    for (var j = 0; j < values.length; j++) {
      var value = values[j].trim(); // trim removes whitespaces from both ends of the string

      // value not already in array
      if (usecases.indexOf(value) === -1) {
        // push addds value to the array (+1)
        usecases.push(value);
      }
    }
  }

  // string array sorted alphabetically in ascending order
  usecases.sort();
  
  
  // create "All" button + as many buttons as there are use cases (sorted in ascending order)
  
  createButton("All", "");
  
  for (var k = 0; k < usecases.length; k++) {
    createButton(usecases[k], usecases[k]);
  }
  
  
  // ########## FUNCTION ########## 
  // checks for each module if it matches the filtered use case
  
  function moduleMatchesFilter(module, filterValue) {
  
    if (filterValue === "") {
      return true; // "All"-button shows every module (because filterValue is empty)
    }

    // access usecase of module
    var usecaseText = module.dataset.usecase;
    // split by comma into seperate terms
    var usecases = usecaseText.split(",");
    
    // iterates through usecases-list of the module
    for (var i = 0; i < usecases.length; i++) {
      // remove whitespaces from both ends of the string
      if (usecases[i].trim() === filterValue) {
        return true; 
      }
    }
  
    // selected usecase not in usecases of the module --> no match
    return false;
  }


  // ########## FUNCTION ########## 
  // building the buttons and adding on-click functionality
  
  function createButton(label, filterValue) {
  
    // create new html element, type: button
    var button = document.createElement("button");
    // edit element as ".tag" in css file 
    button.className = "tag";

    // only "All"-button has empty filterValue --> is set as active by default
    // .tag:active has different style compared to .tag
    if (filterValue === "") {
      button.classList.add("active");
    }

    button.textContent = label; // sets button text/label

    button.addEventListener("click", function () {

      // deactivate all buttons on click
      var allButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".tag");
      for (var i = 0; i < allButtons.length; i++) {
        allButtons[i].classList.remove("active");
      }

      // set clicked button as active
      button.classList.add("active");

      // iterate through all modules. display module if its use case matches filter value
      for (var i = 0; i < modules.length; i++) {
        if (moduleMatchesFilter(modules[i], filterValue)) {
          modules[i].style.display = "";
        } else {
          modules[i].style.display = "none";
        }
      }
    });

    filterContainer.appendChild(button); // add all the buttons as child elements to filter-element so they can be displayed
  }
});

</script>
```
